'''Shock boots''' were a standard-issue military [[Boot/Legends|boot]] that was worn by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. These [[Boot/Legends|boots]] were rugged in construction, and were built to create a lightweight-but-[[Armor/Legends|armored]] boot that protected the foot from harm, as well as allowed the boot to absorb impact when kicking doors down. A solid kick from these boots activated the miniature power generators and electrical circuitry in their soles, delivering a paralyzing shock to an opponent. Nearly identical to regular boots, they often would go unnoticed. They were priced at 1,250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Fly" />
